tier1.notes: Distro package archives are GPG-signed by their respective archive keyrings (debian-archive-keyring, ubuntu-archive-keyring, alpine-keys, redhat-release). Trust is rooted in the host package manager's configuration. Runtime dependency of the Node.js arm64 glibc tarball from 25.0.0 on (links libatomic.so.1; exits 127 without it; measured via readelf NEEDED, see docs/source-build-musl.md). Consumers declare it arch-scoped on their arm64 install method's dependencies[] (the method's platform.arch is the scope), not unconditionally. Package names checked against the live arm64 indexes on 2026-10-26: debian 12/13, ubuntu 24.04/26.04, alpine 3.22-3.24, rhel 9/10 (ubi9/ubi10); none renames the package and none ships it in the base image.
